_comment: TI15 official group draw template. Copy to draw.json and fill with the POSTED draw. Team names must match data/ti2026/inputs/teams.csv 'team' column exactly. podA and podB are 8 teams each. r1_pairings are the posted round-1 matchups: 4 pairs within podA and 4 within podB (round 1 never crosses pods). Then run: python -m ti_predict.predict_ti15 --official --draw data/ti2026/inputs/draw.json --strengths bt --cutoff YYYY-MM-DD
